headline: 1,558 cases in 24h: PM directs stronger dengue prevention nationwide
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has ordered a nationwide push for cleanliness and public awareness to combat the rising number of dengue cases.
details: Four people died and 1,558 others were admitted to hospitals within 24 hours, highlighting the urgency of the current dengue situation.
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman directed that dengue prevention efforts should not rely solely on government agencies but must involve the general public.
The Prime Minister instructed the involvement of disaster management volunteers, BNCC, Rover Scouts, and Red Crescent workers to lead local cleanliness drives.
Key focus areas include keeping homes and surroundings clean, removing stagnant water, and eliminating mosquito breeding sites to raise public awareness.
During a meeting at the Secretariat on Sunday, the Prime Minister also emphasized increasing the treatment facilities and patient management capacity of hospitals at the upazila level.
caption:
1,558 dengue cases and 4 deaths in just 24 hours. The government is now calling for a nationwide mobilization.

Four people died and 1,558 others were admitted to hospitals within 24 hours, highlighting the urgency of the current dengue situation.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman directed that dengue prevention efforts should not rely solely on government agencies but must involve the general public.

The Prime Minister instructed the involvement of disaster management volunteers, BNCC, Rover Scouts, and Red Crescent workers to lead local cleanliness drives.

Key focus areas include keeping homes and surroundings clean, removing stagnant water, and eliminating mosquito breeding sites to raise public awareness.

During a meeting at the Secretariat on Sunday, the Prime Minister also emphasized increasing the treatment facilities and patient management capacity of hospitals at the upazila level.

#Bangladesh #Dengue #PublicHealth #HealthAlert #Prevention

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star

headline: EC to announce UP election schedule this month, says Commissioner
summary: Election Commissioner Anwarul Islam Sarkar confirms that the code of conduct is finalized and preparations for Union Parishad polls are underway.
details: Election Commissioner (EC) Anwarul Islam Sarkar announced on Sunday that the schedule for the Union Parishad (UP) elections will be released within this month.
// The code of conduct for the local government elections has already been finalized, he stated during a briefing at the Election Building.
caption:
The Union Parishad election schedule is coming this month.

Election Commissioner (EC) Anwarul Islam Sarkar announced on Sunday that the schedule for the Union Parishad (UP) elections will be released within this month.

// The code of conduct for the local government elections has already been finalized, he stated during a briefing at the Election Building.
